sentences.sk: Adam sa učí po slovensky a v stredu má hodinu.
sentences.en: Adam is learning Slovak and has a lesson on Wednesday.

sentences.sk: Jeho učiteľka sa volá pani Kováčová.
sentences.en: His teacher is called Mrs. Kováčová.

sentences.sk: Na začiatku hodiny sa ho spýta, ako sa má.
sentences.en: At the beginning of the lesson she asks how he is.

sentences.sk: Adam povie, že sa má dobre, ale je trochu unavený.
sentences.en: Adam says he is well but a little tired.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka mu dá krátky text o rodine.
sentences.en: The teacher gives him a short text about a family.

sentences.sk: Adam číta pomaly a nahlas.
sentences.en: Adam reads slowly and aloud.

sentences.sk: V texte je slovo, ktorému nerozumie.
sentences.en: There is a word in the text that he does not understand.

sentences.sk: Spýta sa učiteľky, čo znamená slovo „súrodenec“.
sentences.en: He asks the teacher what the word “sibling” means.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka vysvetlí, že súrodenec je brat alebo sestra.
sentences.en: The teacher explains that a sibling is a brother or sister.

sentences.sk: Adam má jednu sestru, preto si slovo ľahko zapamätá.
sentences.en: Adam has one sister, so he remembers the word easily.

sentences.sk: Potom spolu hovoria o Adamovej rodine.
sentences.en: Then they talk together about Adam’s family.

sentences.sk: Adam povie, kde bývajú jeho rodičia.
sentences.en: Adam says where his parents live.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka mu pomôže s výslovnosťou dlhých slov.
sentences.en: The teacher helps him pronounce long words.

sentences.sk: Adam zopakuje každé nové slovo dvakrát.
sentences.en: Adam repeats each new word twice.

sentences.sk: Na konci hodiny napíše tri krátke vety.
sentences.en: At the end of the lesson he writes three short sentences.

sentences.sk: V jednej vete urobí malú chybu.
sentences.en: He makes a small mistake in one sentence.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka mu ukáže správny tvar slovesa.
sentences.en: The teacher shows him the correct verb form.

sentences.sk: Adam si opravu zapíše do zošita.
sentences.en: Adam writes the correction in his notebook.

sentences.sk: Doma si chce nové slová ešte raz prečítať.
sentences.en: At home he wants to read the new words once more.

sentences.sk: Teší sa, že každý týždeň rozumie trochu viac.
sentences.en: He is happy that he understands a little more each week.

glossary.note: Present tense, third person singular; sa is part of učiť sa. Here it comes before učí because Adam comes first.
Third person singular; si is part of the verb phrase.

questions.promptSk: O čom je text na hodine?
questions.explanationEn: The lesson text is about a family.
A sibling is a brother or sister.

questions.promptSk: Koľko viet Adam napíše na konci hodiny?
